name: Dorsal Wrist Ganglion Cyst
definition: Benign mucin-filled cyst arising commonly from the scapholunate region on the dorsal wrist.

typical: Visible or palpable dorsal wrist lump

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is usually clinical; ultrasound is useful if the lesion is atypical or occult.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Aspiration or excision is considered for persistent pain/function issues; recurrence can occur.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-granthi phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Benign mucin-filled cyst arising commonly from the scapholunate region on the dorsal wrist.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
